title: Surreal numbers, derivations and transseries
container-title: Journal of the European Mathematical Society
note: Construction of a natural derivation on the surreal numbers extending $d/dx$ on the reals, making $\mathbf{No}$ a differential field.  Provides the Jackson-derivative lift $d_q$ with $q = 1 + \varepsilon$ used in \ref{def:standard-part-functor}.
